findings.title: Admin API client has no tests; errors silently swallowed
findings.note: Highest-scored hotspot (80.0), untested_change_share=1.0, no mapped test found. Fetch failures collapse to a bare null with no assertion, and adminEnabled() checks a flag key absent from FLAGS (always false) with no test catching either behavior.

findings.title: Public API client has no tests; fetch errors swallowed silently
findings.note: Hotspot score 42.9, untested_change_share=1.0, no mapped test found. Empty catch discards all fetch/parse failures with nothing asserting the fallback-to-null or betaBanner log behavior.

findings.title: Checkout dispatch logic (flag-gated money path) has no tests
findings.note: untested_change_share=1.0, no mapped test found. Neither the legacy branch (empty-cart guard, legacyFormat/priceOf composition) nor the flag-gated new branch is exercised, despite computing the customer-facing checkout total.

findings.title: Skipped bulk-pricing test hides a discrepancy with actual pricing output
findings.note: Skipped assertion expects priceOf('A1')===900, but pricing.ts has no bulk logic and returns 1000. The skip masks an unimplemented feature or stale test; bulk pricing has zero real coverage.

findings.title: Coverage threshold configured but never enforced by test run
findings.note: jest's coverageThreshold only fails a run under --coverage; both the 'test' script and CI invoke plain jest, so the 80% gate is dead config and CI cannot fail on the untested hotspot files above.

open_questions.question: Is there a separate integration/e2e suite outside this repo checkout exercising the admin/public API clients over HTTP that a unit-test-only search would miss?

looks_bad_but_fine.why: Untested (change share 0.5) but it is a thin main() wiring addItem+checkout together; treated as glue/entrypoint code per trap guidance, not a standalone finding.
